name: Love Song o Kimi ni...
source: When Akira injures his leg, his dreams of playing soccer are crushed, but a song by the band EDEN helps give him hope again. He gets involved in the band's fan club and starts falling for the fan site administrator, Eve... only to discover that Eve's actually a man!
translation: Akira腿部受伤后，踢足球的梦想就此破灭，但乐队EDEN的一首歌重新带给他希望。他加入乐队的粉丝俱乐部，并逐渐爱上粉丝网站管理员Eve…却发现Eve其实是男人！
